Part 1 of 3

Round 1

Your cover carousel and pile, and three other ways to show the seven years' books. Open on its own

1

Cover carousel your idea

A tab per year over a carousel of the year's covers. Clicking a cover lifts it and opens a board beneath it, its notch pointing at the cover, with the subject, title, description and See more. Try it: switch years, click a cover, click another.

Seven years

Curriculum

2

The pile your idea

A tab per year. The year's books lie in a pile on the left, titles readable along their spines. Clicking a spine draws that book out of the pile: its cover stands beside the pile and its description beside the cover, and the book shown before goes back on the pile. Try it: click the spines.

Seven years

Curriculum

3

The path

The seven years as stations on one line, so the length and order of the programme shows at a glance and the line fills up to the chosen year. The year's books are cream cards (cover, subject, title, first line). A card opens the full view in a dialog, like the folio. Try it: pick a year, open a card.

Seven years

Curriculum

5

Contents page

A kitab's fihrist. Each year is one row with its numeral, its subjects and a fan of its covers. The row opens into a numbered list of books with dotted leaders to the subject, and a book opens into its description. The quietest option, and it reads well on a phone. Try it: open a year, then a book.

Seven years

Curriculum

6

Turn the card

A rail of the years (a row of them on phones) beside a grid of covers, each captioned with its title and subject. Clicking a cover turns it over to the board side, which holds the subject, title, description and See more. Clicking again turns it back. Try it: click a cover.

Seven years

Curriculum

Part 2 of 3

Modern patterns

Three current interface patterns in the site's brown and gold. Open on its own

I

Bento

A segmented year switch whose gold thumb slides to the chosen year, over a bento grid: one book large on the board with its cover and description, the other five as cream tiles numbered 01–06. Clicking a tile moves that book into the large cell, and the tiles glide to their new places. Try it: click a tile, then switch years.

Seven years

Curriculum

II

Year lanes

All seven years at once as tall board panels, each with its numeral and name running up it, so the length of the programme is clear from the start. Clicking a lane widens it to show that year's books in two columns, and a book opens its description at the lane's foot. On phones the lanes stack as rows that open downward. Try it: open another year.

Seven years

Curriculum

IV

Roadmap

Scroll through the years. A large numeral and a seven-step progress track stay pinned at the side and follow along (pinned along the top on phones); clicking a step jumps to that year. Each book is a compact card, and it opens in a drawer that slides in from the right, with Previous and Next to move through the year. Try it: scroll, then open a book.

Seven years

Curriculum

Part 3 of 3

The shelf · One year at a time

The live bookshelf cut into single years, unframed, on a wooden support. Open on its own

R1

Roadmap · oak plank

Modern IV's pinned numeral and progress track on the left, following the scroll. On the right each year is a heading over its books, which stand on a thick oak plank running the column's width, its top face lit. The spines behave as on the site: click one to open its card, then See more for the folio. Try it: scroll, then open a book.

Seven years

Curriculum

R2

Roadmap · wall shelf

The same scroll, with each year's books on a small wall shelf only as wide as the books, hung on two wooden brackets, so it reads as seven shelves up a wall. The year's heading is a quiet centred line, since the pinned numeral already names it. The shelf widens when a book opens and takes the full column for the folio. Try it: open a book, then See more.

Seven years

Curriculum

T1

Tabs · plank

One year at a time. A sliding year switch names the year and its subjects, and below it that year's books stand on an oak plank cut to their width. Switching years brings the new books up onto the plank one after another. Try it: switch years, open a book.

Seven years

Curriculum

T2

Tabs · label plates

The tabs are part of the shelf. The books stand on a long oak board whose front edge carries seven pinned brass label plates, like a library's shelf labels. The chosen plate is lit, and clicking another brings its year's books onto the board. Try it: click a plate.

Seven years

Curriculum

Only Second Year holds real books; the rest are the JSON's placeholders.
